title: Confirm Z3 transferable-feature adaptation on the 160 OOD labels
why: Z3.03 reported OOD AUROC 0.84-0.85 on 60 windows (n_bad=9); confirm on the full 160 human labels (n_bad=22)
hypothesis: The per-domain z-score adapted score stays > frozen 0.566 with a factory-grouped CI excluding 0.5 at n_bad=22
data: labels/ood160_labels.json (138 good/22 bad, 47 factories); Z3 candidates (q1 reuse) + q2 recompute; caches/gpu/features.json + ood160_pixel.npz
method: IndEgo-signed per-domain z-score equal-weight mean; factory-grouped bootstrap CI

title: Per-feature IndEgo vs OOD-160 transfer
why: Report per-feature transfer class at n_bad=22 for the 6 Z3 and 8 stable features
hypothesis: The 6 transferable candidates stay stable at 160; some stable-8 features may flip

summary: Z3 transferable-6 per-domain z-score: OOD-160 AUROC 0.759 [0.597,0.886] grouped, BA 0.709; stable-8+6 0.781 [0.634,0.895], BA 0.733; frozen 0.566. Paired grouped gain +0.19/+0.21 (99.5% >0). Gain holds at n_bad=22; q2 alone (0.70/0.73) not separable from chance.
All 6 Z3 transferable candidates stable on OOD-160; 9 stable/10 flip/1 chance across 20 candidates; selection set unchanged.
